incident_spec.summary: Excessive connection errors and failures in MySQL due to high concurrency from Sidekiq background jobs.
symptoms: Background jobs fail due to connection exhaustion.
incident_spec.mechanism: Sidekiq processes with large connection pools exceed the configured max_connections limit, causing connection errors and job failures.

facts.evidence: The DBA explicitly mentioned max_connections is set to 500.
The post describes Sidekiq running 4 processes, each with a pool of 200 jobs.

assumptions: Sidekiq processes are configured to use persistent connections.
The database server is not configured to handle such high concurrency.
unknowns: Exact workload characteristics of the Sidekiq jobs.
Whether connection pooling is used effectively.

requirements: Database must exist and be accessible.
